name: EMG Gripper Network
description: 3-layer LIF SNN (sensor→interneuron→actuator) for EMG-controlled prosthetic grip. Reads forearm EMG, classifies grip intent, and drives a gripper with spiking motor commands.

metadata.architecture: 3-layer LIF (sensor τ=10ms → interneuron τ=20ms → actuator τ=20ms)

name: Audio Wake-Word Network
description: Cochlear-inspired LIF SNN for neuromorphic audio wake-word detection. Temporal coincidence detection with sensor τ=5 ms. Suitable for always-on edge keyword spotting.

metadata.architecture: 3-layer LIF (sensor τ=5ms → interneuron τ=10ms → actuator τ=20ms)

name: EEG Attention Network
description: SNN for EEG temporal attention classification. Applicable to biosignal monitoring including cardiac arrhythmia detection (ECG) and neural attention decoding.

name: Object Recognition Network
description: Sparse event-camera SNN for 11-class object and gesture recognition on DVS event streams. Input shape 128×128, 30 time bins.

name: Looming Detector
description: Event-camera looming detection SNN. Detects rapid approach of objects from DVS event streams. Safety-critical variant for robotics and autonomous systems.

name: Visual Tracker
description: Spatial visual tracking SNN for DVS event cameras. Tracks moving objects across the event-stream sensor plane.

name: Reflex Arc
description: Biological spinal reflex arc SNN modelling the sensory-to-motor reflex pathway. Applicable as a BCI decoder for primate motor prediction tasks.

name: CPG Rhythm Generator
description: Central Pattern Generator SNN producing rhythmic motor output. Models oscillatory neural circuits for locomotion and periodic control. Applicable to chaotic time-series regression.

name: Prosthetic Reflex Network
description: Prosthetic hand reflex SNN. Detects tactile slip events and generates corrective grip motor commands. Part of the Neuromorphic Prosthetics research track.

name: Slip Reflex Network
description: Fast slip detection SNN for prosthetic grip stability. Optimised for high-frequency slip events (up to 5 Hz). Robustness variant of the Prosthetic Grip benchmark.

name: Coincidence Detector
description: Dual-channel LIF network detecting timing coincidence between two sensory streams. Two independent 10-d input channels each drive their own LIF population, both converging on a shared trigger population.

name: Dopamine STP Decision Circuit
description: Winner-take-all decision circuit: an evidence population drives two mutually-inhibiting choice populations. Feed-forward/recurrent NIR skeleton of a biological decision circuit — short-term plasticity, homeostasis, and dopamine neuromodulation are dropped (not representable in NIR).

metadata.architecture: Input(12) -> evidence (LIF) -> choice_A/choice_B (LIF, mutually inhibiting) -> Output(12)
metadata.dropped_features: short-term plasticity, homeostasis (18 Hz), dopamine neuromodulation (x1.4)

name: 2D Edge Enhancement Grid
description: Lateral-inhibition SNN for contrast/edge enhancement across a 20x20 pixel grid. A retina population excites a contrast population that inhibits itself recurrently, sharpening edges via lateral suppression.

metadata.architecture: Input(400) -> retina (LIF) -> contrast (LIF, self-inhibitory recurrent) -> Output(400)
metadata.dropped_features: local radius connectivity (radius=2/3) — dropped, encode as structured sparse weight matrices via the UI

name: Prosthetic Sleep Consolidation
description: Offline replay/consolidation network for prosthetic grasp episodes. A sensor-replay pathway and an internal interneuron oscillator both drive an actuator population that consolidates grasp patterns during a 'sleep' phase.

metadata.architecture: Input(90) -> sensor (LIF) -> actuator (LIF) <- interneuron (LIF, internal oscillator, no input port) -> Output(90)
metadata.dropped_features: STDP on sensor->actuator pathway — not representable in NIR

name: Probabilistic Decision Maker
description: Probabilistic winner-take-all decision circuit: a weak stimulus drives two mutually-inhibiting choice populations that amplify small initial asymmetries into a stable binary decision.

metadata.architecture: Input(10) -> stimulus (LIF) -> choice_A/choice_B (LIF, 40-d, mutually inhibiting) -> Output(40)
metadata.dropped_features: background noise, homeostasis (15 Hz target), short-term plasticity, neuromodulation

name: Visual Homeostasis Gate
description: Retinal input gated through a salience population via an excitatory linear transform — a minimal attention/gating primitive for vision pipelines.

metadata.dropped_features: transmission delay (2ms), STP (facilitation, recovery=0.08s), lateral inhibition (radius=1), homeostasis (12Hz), dopamine neuromodulation (x1.2)

name: Dream Hand Reflex Arc
description: Reflex arc CNL spec from the Neuro-Dream-Hand prosthetic hand project. Production-validated on the NMTK Dream Hand hardware target. Uses constraint syntax (MUST / MUST NOT) rather than Define syntax.

name: Dream Hand Sleep Arc
description: Low-power sleep arc CNL spec from the Neuro-Dream-Hand project. Reduces power draw during idle periods while maintaining rapid wake-up reflexes.
